A2-01.rule: leave one physical load_hp in {0,1,2,3} out; fit fixed H1_RF only on other loads; held load never used for tuning or acceptance-rule modification
A2-01.note: thresholds define absence of catastrophic condition-shift failure; they are frozen before results

A2-02.evaluation: same fixed H1_RF, official seed, leave-one-load-out; sensitivity only, not reselection
A2-02.diagnostic_rule: report candidate pooled Macro-F1/per-class recall and delta to frozen 1.0s/0.5; never change official window setting here

A2-03.evaluation: same fixed H1_RF, official seed, leave-one-load-out
A2-03.domain_gap: same 08-A biased RBF MMD2 on independent-file mean 26-D vectors standardized by each source plan

A2-04.classifier: exact frozen STEP09 classifier; no retraining
A2-04.rule: for each A-P file, estimate target moments from the other 15 files only, transform held file, then use official mean-window-score aggregation

A2-05.rule: sample 49 source files with replacement within OR/IR/B/N class counts; duplicated files receive distinct bootstrap group identities; refit only frozen H1_RF config; recompute source T1 moments; alpha fixed 0.25; predict frozen A-P windows

A2-06.rule: derive N-class uncertainty from A2-01 and A2-03; no additional experiment

final_checks.formula_code_unit: recompute selected 04-A frozen window features from raw data with STEP04 implementation and compare exact frozen feature table; verify 26 feature order and units
final_checks.result_version: verify 07/09/10/11 frozen identities and SHA-linked interfaces
final_checks.AP_reasonable_setting: re-read/recompute summary from 10-A 9-setting and bootstrap tables plus A2-04/A2-05
final_checks.explanation: verify 11-A faithfulness/stability/sanity status against final 09/10 model identity

p0_pass_rule: A2-01 must meet all frozen closure thresholds and formula/code/unit checks must pass; otherwise STEP12-A2 fails and NEXT_ALLOWED remains 12-A2
